company.name: Mertado
company.shortDescription: Mertado is an online social shopping platform that allows consumers to discover and buy products from communities they frequently visit.
company.description: Mertado is a social shopping company that lets consumers discover and buy new products within the online communities that they frequent. Mertado mirrors the real world shopping experience by enabling users to discover unique products that meet their lifestyle needs, and adds a social context around these purchases.
